name: Duchy of Spoleto
events: King Ratchis of the Lombards besieges Perugia, but is convinced to lift the siege by Pope Zachary.
King Charles II ("the Bald") sets out for Italy, accompanied by his wife Richilde and a number of his chief…
Lambert I, duke of Spoleto, dies while besieging the city of Capua.
Guy II of Spoleto begins a revolt, and assembles an army supported with Arab auxiliaries.
Adalbert II, margrave of Tuscany, revolts (pushed by his wife Bertha) against his cousin, Emperor Lambert II.
Berengar I of Italy becomes Monarch of Italy
